value.signature: fn integer (v : i128) -> Result < Value , ValueError >

review.body: { if v >= 0 { u64 :: try_from (v) . map (Value :: Unsigned) . map_err (| _ | ValueError :: IntegerOutOfRange { value : v }) } else { Negative :: from_i128 (v) . map (Value :: Negative) } }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for value::Value::integer.
